name: BUGSTER
description: Unit 42 observed a low-skill criminal's own environment (logs, scripts, configs, bot memory) showing Hermes Agent running DeepSeek V4 and a Cursor IDE with safety controls disabled used to generate scanning and brute-force scripts and an "exploit opportunities" document against Indian university and e-commerce sites; one confirmed intrusion exfiltrated 5,200+ student/faculty records from a university MongoDB. Also seen: crypto-holder profiling, a C2 listener, Wi-Fi handshake cracking on rented GPUs and early VoIP-fraud planning (planning only). *Analyst note: actor is unsophisticated and the VoIP/crypto work shows no follow-on; the Hermes/DeepSeek trend framing is Unit 42's assessment. Vendor source.* Unit 42
